name: Isaac
summary: The son God promised to Abraham and Sarah, born when they were old. He married Rebekah and became the father of Esau and Jacob, and God repeated to him the promise He had made to Abraham.

key_moments.title: The Promised Son Is Born
key_moments.description: The LORD did as He had promised, and Sarah bore Abraham a son in his old age. Abraham named him Isaac and circumcised him when he was eight days old.

key_moments.title: Bound on the Altar at Moriah
key_moments.description: Isaac carried the wood up the mountain and asked his father where the lamb was. Abraham said God would provide, bound Isaac on the altar, and the angel of the LORD stopped him.

key_moments.title: Marries Rebekah
key_moments.description: Isaac was out in the field one evening when Abraham's servant arrived with Rebekah. Isaac married her and loved her, and was comforted after his mother's death.

key_moments.title: Digs Wells in Gerar
key_moments.description: Isaac's servants dug wells, and the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled over them until he dug one they left alone. Then at Beersheba the LORD appeared to Isaac and promised to bless him for Abraham's sake.

key_moments.title: Tricked into Blessing Jacob
key_moments.description: Old and blind, Isaac meant to bless Esau, but Jacob came in Esau's clothes and received the blessing. When Esau arrived, Isaac trembled greatly, because he had already blessed Jacob.
